newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Matra signs FFR 570 mln deal with Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Matra signs FFR 570 mln deal with Hungary.

text.p: France's Matra Defense has signed an 570 million French franc deal with Hungary to deliver three mobile batteries of air defence missiles, Hungary's defence ministry said on Wednesday.

"Matra will start the deliveries this year," Colonel Jeno Kopasz, head of of the defence ministry's procurement office told Reuters, adding that the weapons would be delivered by the end of the century.
Matra has also signed an offset deal with Hungary's industry and trade ministry covering the total value of the contract, Kopasz said.
Matra will provide training for Hungarian troops both in Hungary and in France, Kopasz said.
Hungary, which started the modernisation of its army, eyeing Nato membership, announced the first tender for the anti-aircraft missiles last September.
He added that two of the other bidders, Daimler-Benz and Sweden's Bofors were also present when the winner was announced and the other bidders will be sent written confirmation tomorrow.
Bombardier unit Short Brothers of Northern Ireland and Hughes Electronics Corp were the other two bidders.

Hungary is expected to prepare an international tender for upgrading its radar system -- a deal of similar magnitude to the rocket purchase -- and an $700 million to $800 million tender for some 30 fighter jets.
